item.title: Soros-backed DA sparks backlash after blaming Old Dominion shooting on pro-gun lawmakers: 'F--- right off'
item.summary: After the deadly shooting at ODU, located in Norfolk, Virginia, the city's Soros-backed DA blamed the tragedy on pro-gun lawmakers and judges despite the shooter's history supporting terrorism.

item.title: Iranian regime spreading anti-Israel propaganda across dozens of social media accounts: report
item.summary: Iran's military arm used dozens of fake social media accounts to push anti-Israel and anti-United States messages, according to a Clemson University report.

item.title: Trump admin's push to end controversial policy extended by Biden sparks backlash ahead of crucial deadline
item.summary: Somali immigrants challenged President Donald Trump's TPS termination in court, alleging racial discrimination behind a policy ending protection for 1,080 recipients.

item.title: NYC boosts patrols amid ‘heightened threat environment,' after gunman rams truck into Michigan synagogue
item.summary: New York City ramps up security as an attack was reported at a Michigan synagogue, leaving a security guard unconscious. Officials condemned 'horrifying' antisemitic violence.

item.title: NFL Network host Jamie Erdahl says 'tragic' family health issue led to show hiatus
item.summary: NFL Network host Jamie Erdahl explained her absence from "Good Morning Football" was due to family health crisis and announced she will return to the show next week.

item.title: Illegal alien's violent tussle with federal officer leads to multiple charges after suspected Biden-era entry
item.summary: Lawmakers in the U.S. Senate remain sharply divided over how to proceed with fully funding DHS as the agency's shutdown neared the 30-day mark.

item.title: White House balks at new CBS staffer over Liz Cheney ties
item.summary: The White House was irked by news CBS News hired a top staffer for ex-Republican Rep. Liz Cheney, a staunch critic of President Donald Trump.

item.title: Ex-North Carolina star Marquise Williams is skipping Tar Heels games as Bill Belichick enters second year
item.summary: Marquise Williams, a former UNC quarterback, said he will not attend Tar Heels football games this season as the Bill Belichick-coached program navigates controversy.

item.title: NASA targets April 1 launch for first crewed moon mission since Apollo
item.summary: NASA is targeting an April 1 launch for Artemis II, its first crewed mission around the moon since Apollo, after a successful flight readiness review.

item.title: Sammy Hagar says he'll never reunite with bandmate Alex Van Halen despite reconciling with Eddie
item.summary: The Van Halen feud deepens as Sammy Hagar reveals he doesn't plan to play with Alex Van Halen again. The former bandmates haven't spoken in decades.
